name: fates-edge-discord-bot
description: Discord bot for Fate's Edge VTT integration
_note_voice: AI GM voice narration (utils/tts-voice.js, optional -- see DISCORD_TTS_ENABLED) additionally needs an Opus encoder and FFmpeg, neither bundled here: `npm install @discordjs/opus ffmpeg-static` (or a system `ffmpeg` on PATH). @discordjs/voice alone is enough for the bot to load; playback is lazily attempted only when the feature is actually enabled, and fails soft with a log message if those are missing.
